    11	# Triple-overlap rings in the finite-stage Picard atlas
    12	
    13	For three charts `U`, `V`, and `W`, the literal triple intersection is presented over
    14	the left chart by
    15	
    16	`Gamma(U intersect V) tensor_[Gamma(U)] Gamma(U intersect W)`.
    17	
    18	The first half of this file proves that this tensor product is the section ring of the
    19	exact triple intersection in the separably closed Picard representer.  The second half
    20	forms the same tensor pushout from the descended restriction maps and proves that scalar
    21	extension commutes with this construction.
    22	
    23	This is the object layer for the triple pullbacks in `Scheme.GlueData`.  Constructing the
    24	cyclic `t'` maps still requires transporting the exact transition comparison through the
    25	finite-stage model equivalences and reflecting its cocycle equation; no such gluing claim
    26	is made here.
    27	-/

    42	/-- If two affine opens lie in an affine open, their section rings and the section ring
    43	of their intersection form a pushout. -/
    44	private theorem isPushout_affineOpenSections_inf
    45	    {X : Scheme.{u}} (W U V : X.Opens)
    46	    (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    47	    (hUW : U <= W) (hVW : V <= W) :
    48	    let T := U ⊓ V
    49	    IsPushout
    50	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hUW).op)
    51	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVW).op)
    52	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).op)
    53	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).op) := by
    54	  dsimp only
    55	  let T := U ⊓ V
    56	  letI : IsAffine W := hW
    57	  letI : IsAffine U := hU
    58	  letI : IsAffine V := hV
    59	  have H : IsPullback
    60	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left))
    61	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right))
    62	      (X.homOfLE hUW) (X.homOfLE hVW) :=
    63	    isPullback_opens_inf_le hUW hVW
    64	  have hi := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen H
    65	    (show (⊤ : (V : Scheme).Opens) <=
    66	      (X.homOfLE hVW) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (W : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    67	    (show (⊤ : (U : Scheme).Opens) <=
    68	      (X.homOfLE hUW) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (W : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    69	    (show (⊤ : (T : Scheme).Opens) =
    70	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    71	          (⊤ : (U : Scheme).Opens) ⊓
    72	        (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)) ⁻¹ᵁ
    73	          (⊤ : (V : Scheme).Opens) by simp)
    74	    (isAffineOpen_top W) (isAffineOpen_top V) (isAffineOpen_top U)
    75	  have hgeo := (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp hi
    76	  have hnat (A B : X.Opens) (hAB : A <= B) :
    77	      (X.homOfLE hAB).appTop ≫ A.topIso.hom =
    78	        B.topIso.hom ≫ X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hAB).op :=
    79	    X.restrictFunctorΓ.hom.naturality (homOfLE hAB).op
    80	  refine hgeo.of_iso W.topIso U.topIso V.topIso T.topIso ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    81	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE hUW).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    82	      (X.homOfLE hUW).appTop from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    83	    exact hnat U W hUW
    84	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE hVW).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    85	      (X.homOfLE hVW).appTop from Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    86	    exact hnat V W hVW
    87	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    88	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= U from inf_le_left)).appTop from
    89	        Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    90	    exact hnat T U inf_le_left
    91	  · rw [show (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).appLE ⊤ ⊤ _ =
    92	      (X.homOfLE (show T <= V from inf_le_right)).appTop from
    93	        Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _]
    94	    exact hnat T V inf_le_right

   106	    (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left.Opens :=

   118	    rw [← Limits.terminal.comp_from J.hom]
   119	    infer_instance
   120	  exact (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U V).2.inf
   121	    (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap C U W).2

   164	/-- The left-chart ring, its two pair-overlap rings, and the literal triple-intersection
   165	ring form a pushout square. -/

   168	    IsPushout
   169	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V).toRingHom)
   170	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U W).toRingHom)
   171	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageOverlapToTripleLeft C U V W).toRingHom)
   172	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (pic0FiniteStageOverlapToTripleRight C U V W).toRingHom) := by
   173	  change IsPushout
   174	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   175	      (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U V)).op)
   176	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   177	      (homOfLE (pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C U W)).op)
   178	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   179	      (homOfLE (show Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W <= U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 from
   180	        inf_le_left)).op)
   181	    (((pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1.left).presheaf.map
   182	      (homOfLE (show Pic0FiniteStageTripleOpen C U V W <= U.1.1 ⊓ W.1.1 from
   183	        inf_le_right)).op)
   184	  exact isPushout_affineOpenSections_inf

   207	/-- The tensor pushout of the two pair-overlap rings over their left chart is the literal
   208	triple-intersection ring. -/

   210	    (U V W : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
   211	    Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V ⊗[Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U]
   212	        Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U W
   213	      ≃ₐ[Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U] Pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C U V W := by
   214	  let e := ((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
   215	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
   216	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U W)).isoIsPushout _ _
   217	      (isPushout_pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C U V W)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv
   218	  refine AlgEquiv.ofRingEquiv (f := e) fun c => ?_
   219	  exact congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct (Pic0FiniteStageChartRing C U)
   220	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U V)
   221	    (Pic0FiniteStageOverlapRing C U W)).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
   222	      (isPushout_pic0FiniteStageTripleRing C U V W)).hom
   223	        ((pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C U V) c))
